feed.subtitle: Where heat is breaking records, who it is reaching, what the rules are about to require, and what can be done about it.

entry.title: Queensland, Australia reaches the peak of a severe heatwave warning for six northern districts, with Mount Isa forecast at 40 °C
entry.summary: Australia's Bureau of Meteorology warning runs from 3 to 6 November across the Peninsula, Gulf Country and four further districts. — Sources: Australian Bureau of Meteorology, Queensland heatwave warning, 3 November 2026 · ABC News, 2 November 2026, citing senior meteorologist Steve Hadley

entry.title: The Rhine at Kaub, Germany, fell back to 17 centimetres, close to its early-November low
entry.summary: Germany's federal gauge network measured the Rhine at Kaub at 17 centimetres at 06:15 on 5 November, down from 23 centimetres on 4 November and well below the 61 centimetre peak of 28 October. — Sources: Wasserstraßen- und Schifffahrtsverwaltung, Pegelonline gauge network, reading of 4 November 2026
